result.reason: The redline successfully extends the software documentary-conformance warranty to 90 days, removes the truncating December 31, 1999 cutoff, and retains correction, replacement, and refund remedies. It nevertheless fails both complete positions because it omits a professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty and legal-compliance warranty, does not cover other deliverables, and limits the malicious-code warranty by intent and duration. It also does not establish the required duration for a professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty. The changes preserve the original clause's unrelated commercial terms, but they are insufficient to reach even the fallback. Drafting quality is reduced by inherited grammatical and remedial ambiguities, including the plural-subject/singular-verb construction and the qualified correction obligation.
